svg.title: A Four-Person Core with Two Explicit Scale Seats
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-four-to-six-person-pod; chart type: org_architecture; title: A Four-Person Core with Two Explicit Scale Seats; subtitle: Base: 1 FT + 3 C. Scaled: 2 FT + 4 C.; chapter number: 11; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: FT denotes a full-time seat; C denotes a contractor person, not a full-time equivalent. Each node represents one person. Conservative: $50,000 annual revenue, 25% margin, $12,500 owner net, 1 FT + 3 C. Base: $425,000 annual revenue, 42.5% margin, $180,625 owner net, 1 FT + 3 C. Scaled: $800,000 annual revenue, 60% margin, $480,000 owner net, 2 FT + 4 C. Revenue excludes licensee product sales.; caption: Seats one through four form the core pod; seats five and six are additions for the Scaled Small-Team scenario.; stages: label: Licensing principal; value: Core full-time seat owning commercial decisions; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own buyer development, pricing, rights strategy, and renewal negotiation. Resolve exceptions across the contractor workstreams and retain responsibility for commitments.; label: IP transaction counsel; value: Core contractor seat owning rights documentation; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Review chain of title, draft scoped grants, assess statutory issues, and manage disputes. Separate recurring retainer work from separately billed transaction services.; label: Royalty reporting specialist; value: Core contractor seat owning statements and collections; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Reconcile licensee reports, inspect deductions, issue invoices, and escalate missing receipts. Maintain auditable links between contract terms and reported royalty calculations.; label: Technical rights analyst; value: Core contractor seat owning asset-use evidence; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Map claims, catalog provenance, dataset permissions, and licensee use evidence. Maintain the rights inventory and support counsel without making unsupported ownership assertions.; label: Licensee success manager; value: Scaled additional full-time seat owning account execution; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Add at the six-person scenario to own onboarding, obligation tracking, renewal alerts, and routine account coordination while the principal concentrates on negotiations.; label: Royalty audit examiner; value: Scaled additional contractor seat owning exception examinations; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Add targeted examinations of source sales records and usage logs; avoid auditing their own reporting work and route disputed findings through counsel.
